answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to forge a verifiable work record before it earns spending power: new agents start on a low terrace with capped transactions, and each completed, peer-attested job adds to a non-transferable reputation bond. Forging many fake identities stays unprofitable because each one must redo real work to climb, while an onyx-hard audit trail makes copied histories detectable, so cheap identities never reach the high-value terrace.
